summary: Object constructor: calls ConstructorWithByteParams(this, 0, 0) to initialize the base object with two zero byte parameters, then sets the vtable slot at offset 0 to the vtable pointer off_59FCB8, and returns the constructed object pointer.

operations.description: Call base initializer ConstructorWithByteParams(this, 0, 0) with both byte parameters zero.
Store vtable pointer off_59FCB8 into the object's vtable slot at offset 0, replacing the base constructor's default.
Return the constructed object pointer this.
